b:
^Bella: Grandmother… at last, you’ve found peace with your sins.

^Cacildes: Then… is it over? Will the curse finally lift?

^Bella: Can’t you feel it in the air? The sun... this light… it’s warmer now. Yes… the curse is broken.

^Bella: The Veilglades are free at last — all because of you. The island can breathe again.

^ And I… I am your follower now. You’ve earned that right. So then… lead the way.

root: ^Loras: Ah, what a fine day… from the sunken depths of the ocean to basking under this summer sun,
^ I’ll be a rusty helmet in no time. But a happy one, all the same.
^Cacildes: Right. We should probably head back to Bartolomeu and share the good news.
^Loras: Indeed. That old skeleton will be overjoyed to hear the island is finally at peace.
